about: Montmagny is a city in Chaudière-Appalaches, Quebec, on the south shore of the St. Lawrence River east of Québec City. Snow-goose migration along the river, a small urban core, and Appalaches countryside inland define this Côte-du-Sud community. About 11,000 people live in Montmagny.
seoSummary: Chaudière-Appalaches St. Lawrence south-shore city east of Québec—snow-goose migration and Côte-du-Sud hub.
